decision: Replace Diplomatic Influence with observed International Alignment, not a causal influence assessment

auditFindings.finding: Frozen external partner series is preliminary; verify archive hash, denominator, source licensing, annual topic mix, matched resolution cohort and independently reproduce calculations before public needle.
Six-code restricted policy-topic cohort differs from full recorded-vote cohort; must show sensitivity and coverage rather than silently interchange percentages.
EU has no sovereign UNGA vote; EU-27 supermajority proxy must be clearly labeled, sensitivity-tested and shown as unavailable when insufficient member agreement.
Existing data.dimensions, weights, actors and evidence maps use Diplomatic as object key; renaming a selector without a compatibility adapter would break lookups.
Model assessment expects four influence assessments with Diplomatic weighted .20; International Alignment is a descriptive percentage and must not be inserted as if it were a net-influence score.
Voting evidence, diplomatic cases, selectedScore, cards and selectors branch on Diplomatic; migration must preserve archived cases in a separate drawer and existing gauge states.
Command-meter tests reference existing dimensions, source registries and moving needle behavior; avoid mass replace of legacy keys and preserve all non-diplomatic paths.

stages.acceptance: Published research audit, tests, no changed UI or model scores

stages.goal: Introduce isolated alignment view-model and independent reproduction
stages.acceptance: Matched partner denominators, EU proxy, abstention/absence and topic sensitivity validated for 2021–2024

stages.goal: Display International Alignment selector with descriptive percent and trend, separate from influence score
stages.acceptance: Feature flag, legacy Diplomatic alias for archived evidence, all existing selectors/needles work; insufficient data shows unavailable

stages.goal: Remove obsolete diplomatic scoring weight from any overall influence composite and revise methodology
stages.acceptance: No mixing of UN voting percent with influence points; overall remains unscored unless independently valid

stages.goal: Retire legacy display label after production smoke test
stages.acceptance: Desktop/mobile checks, rollback switch, four required CI checks and explicit approval
